calls.subject: COST
calls.name: Ines
calls.text:
The membership fee is the business: renewals above 90% and a fee raised every five or six years carry the margin, while the goods are sold near cost.

The price assumes the warehouse count keeps growing abroad; the case holds while renewal rates do.
calls.pathway: Membership income growing faster than sales for the next three years.

pillars.name: Renewals
pillars.text: Renewal rate above 90% in North America.

watch: Renewal rate under 89% in a quarter
A fee rise that slows sign-ups

calls.subject: market: Rates stay higher for longer
calls.name: Theo
calls.text: Core services inflation is sticky near 4% and the labour market has not loosened enough for the cuts the futures price. Long duration lags until wage growth falls under 3.5%.
watch: Two monthly prints of wage growth under 3.5%
